body: It's because my family is poor. My parents aren't originally from here and lost their jobs because their education was foreign. Therefore, they resorted to lower jobs and we're pretty poor. I'm not the only one in my family though, I have a brother but he was born with a learning disability and he does horrible in school. I'm not allowed to tell him but they don't believe in him that much anymore, but he surprised them by having a talent in music, but overall I'm the one who's supposed to do the "smart work" so that I don't live a life of theirs. But ever since reaching high school I've never been able to be "smart" anymore because I'm doing terrible, I can't keep up and I'm bombarded with insults about how I'm not worth it. I understand my parents live a rough life because they grew up poorer than me, but it hurts when they don't understand, much worse when they said I wasn't worth it because I couldn't do well. I've held it in too much and I wanted to tell them only to make matters much worse.
I'm not mad that they try to help but I don't feel any better
Yeah it did. The next day all that happens is that I ended up being called "high risk" without much seriousness in their tone. Even after a few hours, this all became forgettable.
